spans.text: Tony, please allow me to thank you once again for saving my life.

units.rawText: <size=28>That's Lieutenant Izka's watch...</size>
units.displayText: That's Lieutenant Izka's watch...

spans.text: That's Lieutenant Izka's watch...

units.rawText: <size=28>Heh, I can give the sentries the watch and bribe my way in... No, wait!</size>
units.displayText: Heh, I can give the sentries the watch and bribe my way in... No, wait!

spans.text: Heh, I can give the sentries the watch and bribe my way in... No, wait!

units.rawText: What the fuck are you still doing here, asshole? Are you deaf?
units.displayText: What the fuck are you still doing here, asshole? Are you deaf?

spans.text: What the fuck are you still doing here, asshole? Are you deaf?

units.rawText: Actually, I had something to report directly to the Colonel... But since you don't want me around, it can't be helped.
units.displayText: Actually, I had something to report directly to the Colonel... But since you don't want me around, it can't be helped.

spans.text: Actually, I had something to report directly to the Colonel... But since you don't want me around, it can't be helped.

units.rawText: Cheh... What the hell do you mean by that?
units.displayText: Cheh... What the hell do you mean by that?

spans.text: Cheh... What the hell do you mean by that?

units.rawText: Tony gathers up his fallen bottles and dusts the snow off himself before slipping the sentry the watch.
units.displayText: Tony gathers up his fallen bottles and dusts the snow off himself before slipping the sentry the watch.

spans.text: Tony gathers up his fallen bottles and dusts the snow off himself before slipping the sentry the watch.

units.rawText: I got this off a defender officer's body.
units.displayText: I got this off a defender officer's body.

spans.text: I got this off a defender officer's body.

units.rawText: He was an old customer of my salon, and I learned some things about the defender's safehouses from him.
units.displayText: He was an old customer of my salon, and I learned some things about the defender's safehouses from him.

spans.text: He was an old customer of my salon, and I learned some things about the defender's safehouses from him.

units.rawText: Naturally, I want to tell the Colonel this myself. I'd be worried about it going through someone else.
units.displayText: Naturally, I want to tell the Colonel this myself. I'd be worried about it going through someone else.

spans.text: Naturally, I want to tell the Colonel this myself. I'd be worried about it going through someone else.

units.rawText: The sentry carefully studies the watch. Its carvings and designs are too complex for him to understand, but he recognizes the inscription on the back which states when its owner joined the army.
units.displayText: The sentry carefully studies the watch. Its carvings and designs are too complex for him to understand, but he recognizes the inscription on the back which states when its owner joined the army.

spans.text: The sentry carefully studies the watch. Its carvings and designs are too complex for him to understand, but he recognizes the inscription on the back which states when its owner joined the army.

units.rawText: After verifying that Tony is just an ordinary civilian Doll, the soldier thinks carefully about it for a long time before annoyedly tossing the watch to Tony.
units.displayText: After verifying that Tony is just an ordinary civilian Doll, the soldier thinks carefully about it for a long time before annoyedly tossing the watch to Tony.

spans.text: After verifying that Tony is just an ordinary civilian Doll, the soldier thinks carefully about it for a long time before annoyedly tossing the watch to Tony.

units.rawText: Fine, fine, fine, get your ass inside.
units.displayText: Fine, fine, fine, get your ass inside.

spans.text: Fine, fine, fine, get your ass inside.

units.rawText: Thank you, sir.
units.displayText: Thank you, sir.

spans.text: Thank you, sir.

units.rawText: Tony smiles and tucks the watch into a pocket before entering the camp with case in hand...
